examples.japanese: これは{金|きん}でできている。
{金|きん}の{指輪|ゆびわ}は{大切|たいせつ}にしまってある。

examples.english: This watch is made of gold, and it's very heavy.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}が{若|わか}い{時|とき}に{買|か}った{金|きん}の{時計|とけい}を、{今|いま}でも{大切|たいせつ}に{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: I still use with great care the gold watch my father bought when he was young.

{秋|あき}になると、{木|き}の{葉|は}が{金|きん}{色|いろ}になる。
examples.english: In autumn, the leaves turn golden.

examples.english: The evening sky turned golden and was very beautiful.

examples.japanese: {夕方|ゆうがた}、{海|うみ}の{水|みず}が{金|きん}{色|いろ}になっているのを{見|み}て、{本当|ほんとう}に{美|うつく}しいと{思|おも}った。
examples.english: In the evening, I saw the sea water turn golden and thought it was truly beautiful.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}の{金|きん}に{会|あ}おう。
{月|げつ}{水|すい}{金|きん}に{授業|じゅぎょう}がある。
examples.english: I have classes on Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}は{学校|がっこう}が{早|はや}く{終|お}わるから、{友達|ともだち}と{遊|あそ}べる。
examples.english: School ends early on Fridays, so I can play with friends.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}の{夜|よる}はいつも{友達|ともだち}と{食事|しょくじ}に{行|い}くことにしている。
examples.english: I always go out to eat with friends on Friday nights.

notes:
{金|きん} primarily means gold but also abbreviates Friday.

AS METAL:
- {金|きん}メダル (gold medal)
- {純金|じゅんきん} (pure gold)
- {金|きん}{色|いろ} (gold color)
- {金|きん}{貨|か} (gold coin)

AS DAY:
- {金|きん} = {金曜日|きんようび} (Friday)

METAL COMPARISON:
- {金|きん} (gold)
- {銀|ぎん} (silver)
- {銅|どう} (copper/bronze)

DIFFERENT READING:
- {金|かね} = money (same kanji, different reading)
